Central London Office Market Watch Q4 2025 30 January 2026 Article
Central London take-up totalled 2.63 million sq ft in Q4, with 188 transactions completed.
This equates to a vacancy rate of 7.4%, which represents a 40bps fall on the previous quarter
Both the City and West End recorded a decline in supply over the quarter, with vacancy rates reaching 7.0% and 7.9%, respectively.
City Fringe vacancy rate, which stood at 8.2%
West End Fringe sub-markets such as Hammersmith and VNEB, where Q4 vacancy stood at 26% and 18%, respectively.
Space let in BREEAM Outstanding or Excellent office buildings represented 64% of space acquired during 2025, up 5% on 2024.
